What is Outlook-at-Risk?

Outlook-at-Risk provides an objective way of quantifying the risks around future real GDP growth, the unemployment rate, and inflation by capturing how such risks evolve as financial conditions ease or tighten. [...] Outlook-at-Risk is not an official forecast of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, its President, the Federal Reserve System, or the Federal Open Market Committee.

Outlook-at-Risk is a joint product of the Financial Stability Division and the Applied Macroeconomics and Econometrics Center (AMEC).
